name: Tahpanhes
brief: Egyptian city where Jewish refugees fled after Jerusalem's destruction
short: Tahpanhes (or Tehaphnehes), an Egyptian city where Jewish refugees, including Jeremiah, settled after the destruction of Jerusalem (<ref="Jer. 43:7-9; 44:1; 46:14; Ezek. 30:18">Jer. 43:7-9; 44:1; 46:14; Ezek. 30:18</ref>).
